images.author: Jeff the quiet
images.caption: Two ranch houses in the West Fifth Street-West Sixth Street Historic District in Marshfield, Wisconsin: the 1951 Hill house at 1000 W 6th St, and the 1951 Webster house at 1006 W 6th St.

place.source_title: Hill house, 1000 West 6th Street (West Fifth Street-West Sixth Street Historic District)

brief: Long 1951 one-storey ranch house in a historic district of post-war houses: a low hipped roof, pale brick and siding walls, a wide picture window, an attached two-car garage and a broad lawn under tall trees; its neighbour the 1951 Webster house repeats the type.

facade.notes: a 1951 buff-brick hipped ranch with a two-car garage facing the street at one end, flags and lawn ornaments, foundation planting, a driveway across the lawn to the street; a neighbouring ranch of the same family beyond; tall pines and maples along the terrace

why.note: by the 1950s the garage joins the house and faces the street (0-2% outbuildings measured in such tracts)
